title: Choose the visual world for AiFoundIt search (re-roll 3)
question: Steered by your answers: minimal but warm, with one memorable signature, at the polish level of Arc and Linear. The roll assigned Warm Light.

options.label: Warm Light
options.lineage: A desk lamp's pool of light on a tidy desk
options.thesis: Quiet, warm-neutral surfaces. When AiFoundIt finds your file, a soft amber light settles on it.
options.viewport: A small wordmark, a thin indexing line, your question in a soft pill, then the reply. The best match sits in a warm glow labelled Best match; other matches stay plain. Calm move card, dark Move button, floating composer.
options.risk: The glow must mean only 'found'. Used decoratively, it becomes a generic gradient.

raised.raise: When a file is moved, its row moves in place and stays softly lit until you have seen it, never vanishing and reappearing.
Tapping a match opens it full screen; the next match is one swipe away.
The history drawer shows guide words for the span in view (e.g. 'Receipts – Wifi').
One motion timing everywhere: the light settles with a single gentle ease.
Neutrals come from one fixed tonal ramp; the found file is the only lit zone.
One typeface at a few strict sizes; no decorative type.

options.label: Linear Precision
options.thesis: Precise, dark, and dense: files as tidy rows, with a single indigo dot marking the best match.
options.viewport: Indexing line, question pill, reply, files as a bordered list with the best match marked by a glowing dot, and an indigo Move button.
options.risk: Very familiar (it reads as Linear), and colder than you asked for.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.thesis: The best match as a boarding pass; others on a board.
options.case: Loses on both: cold and transactional.
options.kept: Changes move in place and stay lit.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: Each match fills the screen; swipe for the next.
options.case: Loses on both: hides the answer, and doesn't fit chat.
options.kept: The next match is one swipe away.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: Pixel headline type at poster scale.
options.case: Loses on both: loud, not warm.

options.label: Lexicon Page
options.thesis: Answers as dictionary entries; files as color plates.
options.kept: Guide words for the span in view.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Big flat color lobes and capsule buttons.
options.case: Loses on both: playful, not minimal.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Translucent sheets over a tonal ramp.
options.case: Loses on both: technical and cold.
options.kept: One tonal ramp; only the found zone is lit.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A standard AI chat app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The chat layout people already expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Gemini or ChatGPT by design.
